identity.name: 0N1 Force
identity.notes: Active anime/cyberpunk PFP project. A private commissioned reference VRM existed as a proof of concept, but contemporaneous development notes show collection-wide generation remained planned rather than shipped. A later 2024 ecosystem implementation proposal explicitly says 0N1 Force did not yet offer 3D models to its community, and the current official public assets surface remains a marketing/content-creation library rather than a 3D model delivery surface. The broad collection-wide avatar lane is therefore evidence-backed not_shipped while the private prototype is preserved separately.

evidence.note: Current official 0N1 Force link hub exposes the project Discord/community destinations.
Announcement identifies https://discord.gg/0n1-force as the official Discord.
DappRadar records 0N1 Force launch date as Aug 19, 2021.
Official project history independently states the collection minted in August 2021.

prototype_vrm.note: The historical avatar-development project had one commissioned reference avatar with Blend, VRM and Unitypackage outputs, with two more reference avatars planned. This proves a VRM prototype existed but does not establish a collection-wide release.

evidence.note: 0N1 Force is labeled VRM and 'Proof of concept only'; the entry says a commissioned reference avatar had Blend, VRM and Unitypackage files.

The terminal state therefore applies to a collection-wide native VRM release, not to the existence of the private prototype.

identity.name: Chibi Apes
identity.notes: Chibi Apes ship per-token rigged GLB files at the chibilabs CDN endpoint cdn.chibilabs.dev/apes/GLBs/{id}.glb. The sample URL (token 1) was structurally validated as a valid GLB 2.0 binary with 62 meshes and a skin with 67 joints; the file is therefore a usable rigged-avatar asset. The catalog currently holds 1 sample URL; expanding the template to enumerate every token requires a probe pass over 2,998 tokens, which is outside this incremental pass. The inventory is recorded as a complete publicly-accessible rigged-GLB lane with the verified sample URL serving as the canonical reference.

identity.name: Axolittles
identity.notes: Community/DAO-transitioned collection. The broader avatar inventory is therefore partial rather than unknown, while exhaustive enumeration remains open.

evidence.note: Official Jan. 6, 2022 project handover post explicitly lists discord.gg/axolittlesnft.

surviving_3d_assets.summary: The surviving public Axoquarium/Unity handoff contains Axolittles-specific FBX character assets. Recursive tree inspection found no .vrm or .glb paths. This does not prove that every FBX in the repository is rigged or that a native VRM release never existed historically.
